artifacts.caption: FIG. 1 is a view schematically illustrating the process of a method for manufacturing a separator according to an embodiment of the present invention. Referring to FIG. 1 , a die 1 having a first slot 3 a and a second slot 3 b is used to carry out the sequential coating (S 2 ). The slurry 7 , which contains the inorganic particles dispersed therein and a polymer solution including the first and second binder polymers in the solvent, is discharged through the first slot 3 a and is coated on the porous substrate 9 . The non-solvent 5 is discharged through the second slot 3 b and is coated on the slurry 7 . That is, the slurry 7 is coated on the porous substrate 9 supplied onto a rotating roller and the non-solvent 5 is sequentially coated on the slurry 7 .
